---
title: "EdgeBasedModels.jl Vignettes"
subtitle: "Edge-based compartmental models for infectious disease on networks"
---

## Overview

[EdgeBasedModels.jl](https://github.com/epirecipes/EdgeBasedModels.jl) is a Julia package that uses [Symbolics.jl](https://github.com/JuliaSymbolics/Symbolics.jl) and [ModelingToolkit.jl](https://github.com/SciML/ModelingToolkit.jl) to programmatically generate ODE systems for **edge-based compartmental models (EBCMs)** of infectious disease on networks.

The key idea (from [Miller 2011](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11538-011-9655-3) and [Miller & Volz 2013](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.mbs.2023.109060)) is that epidemic dynamics on networks can be tracked through the probability that a random edge has *not* transmitted infection, combined with a probability generating function (PGF) that encodes the network's degree distribution. This avoids expensive stochastic simulations while capturing network heterogeneity exactly.

## Vignettes

These vignettes progress from basic to advanced usage:

| # | Vignette | Description |
|---|----------|-------------|
| 01 | [SIR Basics](01_sir_basics/index.qmd) | Introduction to edge-based models with SIR on a Poisson network |
| 02 | [Network Structure](02_network_structure/index.qmd) | How degree distributions affect epidemic dynamics |
| 03 | [Complex Diseases](03_complex_diseases/index.qmd) | SEIR, SIS, and multi-stage infection models |
| 04 | [Catalyst Integration](04_catalyst_integration/index.qmd) | Defining disease progressions via Catalyst.jl reaction networks |
| 05 | [Multi-type Populations](05_multitype_populations/index.qmd) | Heterogeneous populations with cross-group transmission |
| 06 | [Dynamic Networks](06_dynamic_networks/index.qmd) | Edge swapping, dormant contacts, and serosorting |
| 07 | [Symbolic Analysis](07_symbolic_analysis/index.qmd) | R₀ computation and symbolic inspection of model equations |
| 08 | [Clustering](08_clustering/index.qmd) | Triangle-aware EBCMs on clustered networks |
| 09 | [Degree Correlation](09_degree_correlation/index.qmd) | Assortative and disassortative mixing via correlated PGFs |
| 10 | [Method of Stages](10_method_of_stages/index.qmd) | Erlang-distributed waiting times via stage chaining |
| 11 | [Multiplex Networks](11_multiplex_networks/index.qmd) | Multi-layer networks with shared nodes |
| 12 | [Categorical Composition](12_categorical_composition/index.qmd) | Composing and stratifying open EBCMs |
| 13 | [Final Size](13_final_size/index.qmd) | Analytic final size, epidemic probability, and confidence bands |
| 14 | [Edge-based vs Pairwise](14_edge_vs_pairwise/index.qmd) | Cross-package comparison: EBCM vs NodeBasedModels' pair-closures |
| 15 | [Reinfection Counting](15_reinfection_counting/index.qmd) | SIS reinfection strata on top of the EBCM aggregate |
| 16 | [Cross-package SIS](16_cross_package_sis/index.qmd) | EBCM, node-based closures, and Gillespie on one SIS benchmark |

## Release highlights

This release hardens the package as part of the three-package
`EdgeBasedModels` / `NodeBasedModels` / `NetworkOutbreaks` ecosystem:

- SIS reinfection-counting EBCM builder (`build_sis_reinfection`) with
  aggregate consistency tests against `build_sis`.
- Categorical composition and Lean-backed marginalisation results (T1--T7)
  documenting when closed dynamics commute with subgraph marginalisation.
- Cross-package SIS benchmark vignette with matched node-level initial
  prevalence across EBCM, node-based closures, and stochastic Gillespie.
- Weak/test/vignette dependency structure that avoids circular precompilation
  warnings while preserving `NetworkOutbreaks.OutbreakModel(...)` adapters.

## Getting Started

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/epirecipes/EdgeBasedModels.jl.git
cd EdgeBasedModels.jl

# Install the package
julia --project=. -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.instantiate()'

# Set up vignette dependencies
cd vignettes
julia --project=. -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.instantiate()'

# Render vignettes (requires Quarto)
quarto render
```
